selection: Every Yes and No token for all 11 Chicago daily temperature conditions; no signal or outcome selection
missing_snapshot_policy: Extend earlier hourly partitions only for conditions missing an initial snapshot, up to 24 hours before decision; retain missing data explicitly
causality: Use only timestamp_received strictly less than each decision boundary; depth state follows received sequence
continuity: Archive collector continuity assumed across quiet intervals and hourly partitions, not independently proven
reconciliation: Initial full snapshot required; BBO mismatch invalid until actual depth deltas restore both top prices or another full snapshot
current_market_metadata_usage: Condition and token identity and bucket label only; orderMinSize retained as reference-only, never historical evidence

unchanged_strategy.forecast_mu_sigma: Reuse original 30-day calibration; do not refit on these days

study_status: Exploratory follow-up after trade-print study and conditional 20-signal L2 audit; not a new untouched holdout
